hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null; exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/codex-asked"
#> > $null; $PSModuleAutoLoadingPreference = 'None'; $h = "$env:USERPROFILE\.harness\bin\harness.exe"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($h)) { $h = $null; foreach ($d in $env:PATH -split ';') { if ($d -match '^([a-z]:\\|\\\\)' -and [IO.File]::Exists("$d\harness.exe")) { $h = "$d\harness.exe"; break } } }; if ($h) { & $h device codex asked *> $null }; exit 0
